name: coap_token_validation
description: CoAP token validation per RFC 7252 Section 3. TKL field bounds and token semantics.

vectors.name: tkl_0_empty_token_valid
vectors.description: TKL=0 means no token bytes follow. Valid for requests where token matching not needed.

vectors.name: tkl_9_reject
vectors.description: TKL=9 is reserved and MUST be rejected (RFC 7252 Section 3).

vectors.name: tkl_10_reject
vectors.description: TKL=10 is reserved and MUST be rejected.

vectors.name: tkl_15_reject
vectors.description: TKL=15 is reserved and MUST be rejected.

vectors.name: tkl_mismatch_truncated
vectors.description: TKL=4 but only 2 token bytes follow. MUST reject (truncated message).

vectors.name: token_zero_bytes_vs_empty
vectors.description: Token of all-zero bytes (TKL>0) is distinct from empty token (TKL=0).

vectors.name: con_request_should_have_token
vectors.description: CON request without token (TKL=0) is syntactically valid but clients SHOULD include token for matching.

vectors.name: response_token_must_match_request
vectors.description: Response token MUST match request token for request/response matching.

vectors.name: response_token_mismatch_reject
vectors.description: Response with different token than request MUST NOT be matched.
